text: The extracted repair function accepts folder, and accepted folder properties passes gMsgFolder to its rebuildSummaryCallback. about3Pane observes folder-needs-repair and delegates the queried subject to FolderCommands. Keep the target explicit instead of recovering it from a currently selected row; notification and properties-dialog entry points can refer to different UI state. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Folder repair takes the target folder explicitly across UI entry points
